name: Matteo Falco
note: Named as the father in the baptisms of at least five children at Arienzo between 1767 and 1786, and again in his son Giuseppe's marriage record. He appears as a witness at an Arienzo marriage in 1759, so he was an adult by then. He replaces the Agostino Falcone previously carried at the head of this line.

name: Pasquale (Pascuale) Falco
note: Baptised in the Collegiate Church of Sant'Andrea at Arienzo on 24 October 1767 — the record names his father Matteo and his mother Francesca Crisci. He married Chiara Rivetti and their children were baptised in the same church from 1789 to 1802.

name: Vincenzo Falco
note: His civil marriage act — Arienzo, act 26 of 15 December 1814 — records him as aged 21, a contadino, and “figlio maggiore di Pasquale Falco”: eldest son, and his father named without “fu”, so Pasquale was still living. His wife Andreana is “figlia di Arcangelo”. The parish record of the same marriage names his mother Chiara Rivetti and Andreana's mother Ruggiero. His death record of 15 May 1875 names Pasquale a third time.

name: Raffaele Falco
note: Baptised at Arienzo in 1818 — “ex Vincentio Falco, e Andreana Crisci coniugibus huius Parochiae, cui imposuit nomen Raphael”, with Gelsumina Ruggiero as godmother. His death record of 21 April 1880 names his father as Vincenzo. His wife Angela Rosa Morgillo, daughter of Orazio, died six days before him.

name: Carmine Antonio Falco
note: Birth record of 10 July 1850 names his father as Raffaele. Five further children recorded at Arienzo, 1873–1883.

name: Raffaele Falco
note: A farmer of Arienzo. His last recorded child, Gerardo, was born in 1913 not at Arienzo but at Arpaia, over the provincial border — the first sign of the move north.

name: Carmine Antonio (Carminantonio) Falco
note: Born at Arienzo, resident in the province of Benevento, died at Brisbane and buried at Nudgee Cemetery in niche CHAP-082-B2. His wife Filomena Annecchino died on 10 August 1988 and lies beside him in B1. Two of their sons, Carmine and Raffaele, married two Zampiello sisters of Arpaia and both brought their families to Brisbane.

name: Carmine Falco
note: Born at Forchia in the Valle Caudina. He and Francesca reached Brisbane about 1957 with their daughter Giuseppina — the Brisbane immigration file names her as “known as Josephine”. Francesca died at Brisbane on 10 September 2022 and is buried at Nudgee, plot V-0949.

name: Giuseppina Falco
note: Born at Benevento; her twin daughters were born at Brisbane in 1988.
